title: A qcqs object U of the pro-etale site of an arbitrary scheme X admits an augmented simplicial finite formal family of spectra of w-contractible rings in the qcqs slice over U
statement: A qcqs object U of the pro-etale site of an arbitrary scheme X admits an augmented simplicial finite formal family of spectra of w-contractible rings in the qcqs slice over U. Every proper-face cone is limiting and the associated matching arrow is a componentwise finite cover, with its canonical projection equations.

source.place: Tag 09A1, lemma-w-contractible-hypercovering (2), qcqs subsite and finite formal-family construction

proof.text: Take the qcqs subsite and its basis of literal w-contractible spectra. The singleton covering theorem supplies finite basis covers, and affine sources are qcqs. The qcqs geometry theorem permits adjoining any prescribed finite collection of degeneracy arrows to a cover. Apply the finite-basis hypercover theorem in its u+1 index universe. Retain its finite degree index types, basis witnesses, limiting proper-face cones, canonical matching projections and component covering presieves. This works for the empty base and empty families.

theorem exists_formal_wContractible_hypercover (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt)
    (hUqc : CompactSpace U.left) (hUqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left) :
    ∃ (T : Qcqs X)
      (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{u + 1} (Over T)))
      (M : ∀ n : ℕ, Cone (K.properFaceDiagram n))
      (μ : ∀ n : ℕ, K _⦋n⦌ ⟶ (M n).pt),
      T.obj = U ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, Finite (K _⦋n⦌).I) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : (K _⦋n⦌).I),
        ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec D ⟶ X) (hf : WeaklyEtale f),
          IsWContractibleRing D ∧
            ((K _⦋n⦌).obj i).left.obj = @Scheme.ProEt.mk X _ f hf) ∧
      (∀ n, Nonempty (IsLimit (M n))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory n),
        μ n ≫ (M n).π.app (op a) = K.map a.obj.hom.op) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : (M n).pt.I),
        Presieve.ofArrows
          (fun i : {i : (K _⦋n⦌).I // (μ n).f i = j} ↦ ((K _⦋n⦌).obj i.val).left)
          (fun i ↦ ((μ n).φ i.val).left ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ ((M n).pt.obj k).left) i.property)) ∈
          qcqsPrecoverage X ((M n).pt.obj j).left)
